security.title: Account Security
security.subtitle: Your data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. Choose a strong password to protect your account.

modal.title: Change Password
modal.subtitle: Choose a new password, different from the old one.

twoFA.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twoFA.description: Receive a code upon login to secure your account. It is {{obligatory}} for administrator accounts.

identity.title: Identity Verification
identity.description: Optional. Once verified, an {{badgeLabel}} badge reassures your future roommates. Verification will be done via your mobile carrier (USSD: Telma / Orange / Airtel), with no SMS fees.

privacy.title: Personal Data
privacy.subtitle: You control the use of your data, in compliance with GDPR.

analytics.title: Data usage for anonymized analytics
analytics.description: Helps understand the flatsharing market in Madagascar. Anonymized data, never resold.

partners.title: Receive information from partners
partners.description: Solidarity offers, housing, student jobs. No intrusive commercial solicitation.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.line1: Listings and texts: archived for 5 years (publicly invisible), then automatically purged.
retention.line2: Photos: kept for up to 1 year max.
retention.line3: You can request the export or deletion of your data at any time.

deleteAccount.title: Delete My Account
deleteAccount.description: This action is permanent: your listings, alerts, and conversations will be deleted.

modal.title: Delete your account?
modal.description: All your data (listings, alerts, conversations) will be permanently erased. This action is irreversible.

messages.passwordValidation: Please check the filled fields (password must be at least 8 characters).
messages.passwordUpdateError: An error occurred during the update.
